caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers with a reddish-brown finish. The chest is composed of two main sections: an upper portion with five drawers, three small drawers at the very top and two larger ones below, and a lower portion with three larger drawers. Each drawer has ornate gold-colored handles. The top of the chest is decorated with a curved and scrolled pediment, featuring two finials on each end and a central decorative motif in relief. The lower section of the chest is supported by four curved cabriole legs ending in pad feet. There is a fan-shaped carved detail in the center of the bottom-most row of drawers. The entire piece is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Highboy
